# SopKit — Detailed capabilities index

> SopKit is a privacy-first web utility platform. Most utilities (image processing, PDF manipulation, developer converters, formatting, and calculators) run client-side inside the user's browser sandbox using standard Web APIs, Canvas, and WebAssembly. No user files are saved to remote databases.

Canonical Base URL: https://sopkit.space
LLMs Index: https://sopkit.space/llms.txt
Agent Policy: https://sopkit.space/ai.txt

## Core Architecture & Security Model

- **Browser-First sandboxed execution**: Utilizes client-side WebAssembly, Canvas, and DOM APIs where applicable. Files remain in local browser memory.
- **Transparent processing notices**: Every tool explicitly discloses its execution model (client-side vs external service) in visible page badges, structured data, and headers.
- **Zero account requirement**: Core utilities operate without login, registration, or tracking cookies.
